parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Minimum value: 1.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. If you do not specify a time range, all historical deployment records of the instance are queried.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the edge instance. On the **Edge Instances** page of the [IoT Platform console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the name of the target edge instance to obtain instance ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to obtain instance ID.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for the public instance. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 30. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. If you do not specify a time range, all historical deployment records of the instance are queried.
